pruning: fixed per-layer A rows/B columns physically removed after train-only activation calibration; original 128-score router retained
calibration: 4 evenly spaced frames from each of 40 training demonstrations; 160 train-only images, native autoregressive inference
importance: sum over calibration tokens of (A*x * selected_score)^2 times squared L2 norm of B column; heuristic, not exact SVD energy
benchmark: same 32 fixed validation images, batch1, 3 warmup calls, 3 rounds, CUDA synchronized, one process at a time
baseline_simulation: reuse preserved full-SP eta0.9 five trials, check state/image hashes on newly executed variants
